stops.note: combined 'chilli' (chili pepper) and 'quilitl' (greens/herbs), describing chili-covered tortilla pieces
first recorded in a Nahuatl-Spanish vocabulary compiled by the friar Alonso de Molina
stops.meaning: fried tortilla pieces simmered in chili sauce

stops.note: borrowed into English through Mexican breakfast cuisine
stops.meaning: a Mexican dish of fried tortilla strips simmered in salsa

current_meaning: a traditional Mexican breakfast dish of fried tortilla pieces simmered in red or green salsa
